name: Emmanuel Konan
headline: Cybersecurity Consultant | Applied Cryptography & IT/OT/IoT Security
summary: CentraleSupélec engineer working on technical security audits, industrial and embedded systems, and cryptographic infrastructure. Experience with PKI/HSM, PKCS#11, EBIOS-RM risk analysis and ISO/IEC 27001 internal audits. Coauthor of the EAP-PSK-256 Internet-Draft.

bullets: Conduct risk analyses using EBIOS-RM and contribute to architecture, configuration, source-code, organizational and physical security audits in PASSI engagements.
Perform internal ISO/IEC 27001 audits and work on security specifications, qualification and audits of industrial and embedded equipment.
Act as a cybersecurity referent for OT/IoT equipment at Enedis, with work spanning PKI/HSM, PKCS#11, cryptography and equipment inventory/mapping.
Worked on embedded-system security for the electricity distribution network, combining risk analysis with a defense-in-depth approach.
Contributed to work involving HSMs, PCB penetration testing, power-line communication, and Python/Bash scripting.
Implemented data-informed procedures addressing non-technical losses and electricity consumption fraud; created Excel/VBA KPIs for operational monitoring.
Followed the Data Protection Impact Assessment as a business owner and drafted personal-data passports for the DPO as a business analyst.

contribution.title: EAP-PSK-256 — Cryptographic protocol contribution
contribution.text: Coauthor of an individual Internet-Draft proposing an evolution of EAP-PSK: AES-256, key derivation based on NIST SP 800-108, and contributions from both peer and server randomness. Work in progress; not an RFC or an IETF-endorsed standard.
